implementation_notes: Build with optimisation on from the start and read the generated assembly before micro-tuning. Use `std::vector` contiguity, avoid `std::function` in hot loops (devirtualise with templates or devirtualization hints), and benchmark with `std::chrono` plus a stable input set.
idiom_name: release build + assembly inspection + microbenchmark harness
pitfalls: Assuming the optimiser preserved a volatile-free loop
Micro-benchmarking a single operation that gets hoisted out of the loop
